request.message: What is the primary goal of the ENERGY STAR program in which Apple participates?

response.answer: The ENERGY STAR program is a partnership with electronic equipment manufacturers to promote energy-efficient products; reducing energy consumption of products saves money and helps conserve valuable resources. [E1]

evidences.text:
As an ENERGY STAR® partner, Apple has determined 
that standard configurations of this product meet the 
ENERGY STAR® guidelines for energy efficiency. The 
ENERGY STAR® program is a partnership with electronic 
equipment manufacturers to promote energy-efficient 
products. Reducing energy consumption of products 
saves money and helps conserve valuable resources.
